name: wind-up-rush
description: Wind-Up Rush — wind-up toy racing on Base

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run frontend" "npm run backend"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:vocab && npm run check:verifier && npm run test:unit
scripts.dev:reset: lsof -nP -iTCP:3001 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs -r kill -9; lsof -nP -iTCP:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs -r kill -9; echo 'ports cleared'
